Resolves #19717

Animated component lists now move retained cards directly to the latest Store order. Animate lets the synchronous fine event own presentation before a coarse load can rebuild it, maps descriptors to the records they display, and replaces older settlement work. Index-pooled components keep their displayed addresses until normalization, so record changes during motion update the correct card. Store's load-on-sort notification remains unchanged.

Evidence: L3 (real App Worker and Chromium DOM targets, identities and sampled painted positions) → L3 required (all four Engine ACs). Residual: installed Fleet revalidation, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#505 / neomjs/neo-agent-institution#12.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge:** The deferral makes every coarse load of an animated component list render one microtask later, not only the sort-time one. Code that sets `store.data` and reads the list's items in the same tick now sees the old items. An additive marker on the Store's sort-time `load` (for example `{items, sorted: true}`) would let the plugin skip that one load synchronously and drop the microtask and `loadSerial`, without suppressing the event #16559 protects. Non-blocking; the current shape is tested.

**Documented search:** I looked for (1) DOM moves breaking transitions or focus: `DeltaUpdates` moves with `moveBefore()` where available, and the spec asserts the same node and retained focus; moves at sort start predate this PR via the old load rebuild. (2) A same-tick `filter` cancelling a deferred replacement load: the collection fires `filter` only from `filter()` and `onFilterChange`, never on data replacement, so the roster's Hide-offline polling keeps its load. (3) Leaked owner overrides: `endIndexedMotion` restores the three getters on settlement, coarse load, rebuild and destroy. No defect found.

*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: Address presentation by the record a node shows, not by its position in an array another handler may already have rewritten.
